page.overview:
Who is Giyu Tomioka?

Giyu is a fairly tall young man of a lean muscular stature and pale complexion, consistently seen wearing a stoic expression. He has raven-black hair of uneven lengths, with jaw length side-bangs, a low messy ponytail at the base of his neck, and bangs falling over his eyes in a choppy fringe. His eyes are sharp and moderately large; his irises are lapis blue that fades into a lighter shader at the lower part, surrounded navy blue pupils. His irises are sometimes completely opaque and empty. His eyes are framed by thin eyebrows.

Giyu wears the standard Demon Slayer Corps uniform, colored black in the manga and tinted charcoal blue in the anime. It consists of a button-up jacket with a stand-up collar and long sleeves. Additionally, it features gold buttons and a shirt pocket on the left breast, with the kanji for |Metsu}} engraved on the back of the uniform. Beneath the jacket, he wears a white long-sleeved collared undershirt. The uniform is fastened at the waist with a white belt and includes a pair of matching tattsuke-hakama pants, wrapped at the calves with buttoned white kyahan. On his feet, he wears tabi socks that match the tone of his uniform, along with white zōri sandals with navy blue straps. Over this, Giyu wears a distinctive haori that is split down the middle into two contrasting halves - the right half being a carmine color, the left half decorated in a traditional geometrically patterned rhombi consisting of green, dark green, orange, and yellow. These haori halves are sentimental mementos, with the red side formerly belonging to his late older sister, Tsutako Tomioka, and the patterned side to his deceased friend and fellow apprentice, Sabito.

During the Demon Slayer Corps' battle against Muzan Kibutsuji, Giyu loses his right arm. Following the fight, Giyu cuts his hair down to neck length. He is seen wearing a button-up collared shirt under a kimono with umanori hakama pants.

While Giyu was training under Sakonji Urokodaki, he wore a dark red haori which would later make up his current one as well as black tucked-in tattsuke-hakama pants. He also wore his current white leg-wrapped kyahan and pair of white zōri with dark blue straps. In addition, he wears the warding masks that are signature to Sakonji's pupils. For Giyu, it is a white fox mask with light blue eyes.

Also known as: Giyu, Giyuu, Water Hashira, Tomioka Giyu.
